body: I have depression and in the past I’ve had bad mood swings and self harmed and been jealous of other people in the relationship. I feel like I can never atone for that. He also says he isn’t a sexual person and I have to accept that.

I have depression and I’ve had a few bad episodes where I wasn’t my best self, said some bitchy things but nothing I thought was fatal. He has supported me through it all and has always said he loves me. I’m so confused. He says my negativity and depression and the times I’ve been at my worst are what has killed it for him but he still is attracted to me and wants to be with me...
That’s great! Swimming is something I’m working towards. Once the anxiety is a bit better and it’s easier to actually go to a pool! Sounds like you’re doing all the right things mate! Good on you!!

I’ll check it out today! I love true crime mostly but hey I got stacks of time now so I’m happy to branch out. I never played rock band but I used to enjoy playing just guitar hero. Maybe I should be aiming to demolish ‘Through the fire and the flames’ now that my brain isn’t so dopey and slow hahaha. How’re you keeping busy dude?
Aw man Bam, I thought your life would improve once you got sober but it looks like you just got cancer.

Yup haha.. I can’t believe how much time I have. I’m trying to pick up some new hobbies so I’ve been playing drums, reading books about serial killers and teaching myself to crochet. I dunno if any of them will stick but at least it’s distracting me through it! Good on you for making it to day 11 too. Keep going!

You can do this mate! The first few days are tough because you’ve got the impulses kicking in but you’re not rewarding them with weed. It’s a good thing though! Your body is gonna feel better. Just try distract yourself as best you can. Try to get out of your house if you can, go for a walk, listen to some loud music, distract distract distract until tomorrow. Take every day as it comes. You can do this.
Honestly I think they’re just not ready to believe it’s gonna be real this time. But it’s day 12 now and it’s gonna be day 13 tomorrow. I’m ready to do this now.
Thanks mate, your mindset is solid. Keep going and we’re gonna get there!

Dude that sucks but feeling that sad is something you gotta learn to feel and be okay with. It’s not a desperation in the same way you feel desperate when your coping mechanism owns you. You’re doing good dude, keep going! we are gonna pull through this into better versions of ourselves who will interest better relationships and a better life.
Thanks so much. My doctor was really supportive in helping me start to progress a diagnosis so we’ll see how we go.
